about: Sentry issues owned by another program. stability-health.py lists them in its other-owner row and does not count them against p10 done check 21. Every entry needs owner, eta and github_issue. An entry claims a Sentry issue only by identity: the Sentry issue links github_issue (Link GitHub Issue in Sentry), or its short id is in sentry_issues. Title or stack patterns are refused, because they also claim own stalls. Remove an entry when its owner lands the fix.

owners.eta: the fork release at CEF API >= 30 and its pin (p01-process-178, cut by hour 12 of the chrome-parity push)
owners.why: 10 s makeKeyWindow stall on macOS 14/15 needs CEF fork API 30 (p10-stability.md risk 13)
